title: The Raven and the Snake
plan_warnings: The snake is the one large new character (effort L). If time is short, build path, out, wave, rear, limp and tongue first; coil and strike are only needed inside the small thought cloud and can be simple.
Person figures at s 0.45 in the plan board are near the 110 px legibility floor: check a still at phone size; if unreadable, replace them with two bold head-and-body icons.
islandHut, riverBank and figTree positions are taken from the catalogue picture, not measured: confirm the right-bank ground height and the roof ridge point before placing the woman, rock and raven.
The script says "several people ran after him"; the plan uses three (the woman and two men). Add a fourth villager variant only if the chase looks thin.

Carrying the dead snake away on the staff (137.6) is a staging choice to explain why the burrow stays empty; the script only says they killed it. Drop it if the client finds it too dark: leave the limp snake behind the mound instead and remove it under the day cycles.
The LATER card sits over the spoken words "wa ba'da mudda" (150.73-152.5); it is visual only, and subtitles stay readable in the caption panel.
